name: Industrial IoT and wireless sensors
principle: Interconnected sensors and devices send data over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, LoRa or cellular to services that analyse it. MQTT, OPC and DDS are named protocols.

process_steps.name: Sensors measure on the device layer
Content layer shows it to users

performance.basis: some studies as quoted in the article
